## Triggers & guarantees

- **deterministic rotation** — word selection is by date with no API, tokens, or network calls; the same date always yields the same word.
- **data-only additions** — the word bank shape mirrors exactly what the Resting Screen design renders, so adding a word is data-only, never a layout change.
- **day-one fidelity** — the first word is 설레다, ensuring day one matches the approved mockup.
- **pronunciation accuracy** — the `sound` field is deliberately not the same string as `roman`, as romanization is not a pronunciation guide.

## Decision semantics

### Word rotation

Inputs: local calendar date. Verdict: the word entry selected from the global `window.KOREAN_WORDS` array. Deterministic by date; no API, tokens, or network calls involved.

### Hero line sizing

Inputs: syllable count of the selected word. Verdict: the hero line auto-shrinks past 4 syllables; the design breathes best at 2–3 syllables.

## Constants that matter

| name | value | consequence |
|---|---|---|
| syllable shrink threshold | 4 | hero line auto-shrinks past 4 syllables |
| preferred syllable range | 2–3 | design breathes best at 2–3 syllables |

## Word bank contents

The global `window.KOREAN_WORDS` array holds the word bank. Each entry includes Korean text, romanization, pronunciation, part of speech, meaning, syllables, and example sentences. Each entry also includes a per-syllable array with hangul and romanization for the 'Syllables' block, and an example sentence pair in Korean and English for the 'In use' block. The part of speech is shown after 'Means · ' in the design.
